title: 第一卷 第3章 八十年苦等炼气二层第一卷 第4章 有点意思
slug: 凡人修仙从百岁老人娶妻开始
lines: 几十年苦修都未曾撞破的瓶颈，瞬间便有所松动！
庞大的灵气自果实中溢出，林寻谨守心神，全力运转《长春功》，引导那股洪流在经脉的固定路线前进。
良久之后。
随着啵的一声轻响。
林寻身躯一震，体内灵气瞬间突破关隘，一股灵压从体表四溢而出，继而形成风压，在屋内掀起一阵微风。
他的周身同时泛起一层青色光晕，且光晕更加凝实。
炼气二层！
终于到了！
林寻长舒一口气，而后哈哈大笑，
“这就是炼气二层！”
不知是激动还是委屈，他的眼睛竟湿润起来。
八十年，八十年啊！
这颗压在心头的巨石，终于被搬开了！
他终于摆脱炼气一层废物的头衔！
果实的效果确实拔群！
真能借此修仙！
他细细感受着自身，与炼气一层的时候相比，灵力雄厚近半，感知也更加敏锐。
连身体都年轻了几分，他觉得自己还能再活二十年！
这种状态，与下山时的油尽灯枯完全不同。
甚至连脸上的皱纹，都消退了几分。
年轻，真好啊！
看着镜子中的自己，林寻有些亢奋。
仙路艰难，但他现在有了宝树，终于多了可能！
他起身，推开门走到院中。
今日的阳光似乎格外明媚，天空一片晴朗，与仙宗内云雾缭绕的阴霾天空截然不同。
金丹修士？
林寻握紧拳头，在嘴角勾起一丝弧度！
他的道心更加坚定，但求长生！
片刻之后，林寻返回房间，见杨芸已经将屋内收拾妥当，倒是贤惠。
杨芸见到来人，害羞地低下头，“老爷，今天我起晚了，没有服侍老爷更衣。”
林寻摸摸杨芸的头不以为意道：“你好好在床上歇着，待会我让下人把菜饭送来。”
杨芸心中颇为感动，可很快被林寻的下一句，惊得说不出话来。
“好好修养，夜里我再来疼你。”
杨芸脸色一红，连忙道：“老爷，那种东西还是少吃的好，妾身，妾身确实有些不受征伐。”
林寻一愣，盯着杨芸看了半晌，这小娇妻说的不错，虽然他现在修为增进，不用那玩意也能行。
但，杨芸只是一介凡人，长久下去根本扛不住。
得想个办法让她提升实力才行。
要不，就习武吧？
杨芸见林寻盯着自己不说话，低下头带着哭腔道：
“老爷，我，我能行的，只要您今晚温柔点就好。”
林寻哈哈大笑，上前捏了捏杨芸的嫩脸，“怎么还叫老爷？忘了昨晚叫什么？”
杨芸闻言，如同炸了毛的小猫，慌忙将头埋进被子里，怯生生地回应：“夫，夫君！”
“好，芸儿，你先休息，我去去就回。”
林寻刚打开门，就碰见王管家，只见他献宝似的举着手中袋子：
content_en:
The bottleneck that had not been broken through decades of hard work was loosened in an instant!
Huge spiritual energy overflowed from the fruit. Lin Xun guarded his mind and ran the "Changchun Gong" with all his strength, guiding the torrent to advance along the fixed route of the meridians.
After a long time.
With a soft bang.
Lin Xun's body shook, and the spiritual energy in his body instantly broke through the barrier. A stream of spiritual pressure overflowed from the body surface, and then formed wind pressure, setting off a breeze in the house.
A layer of cyan halo appeared all over his body at the same time, and the halo became more solid.
Second level of Qi refining!
Finally arrived!
"Huh~"
Lin Xun breathed a long sigh of relief, and then laughed,
"This is the second level of Qi Refining!"
I don't know whether it was excitement or grievance, but his eyes became moist.
Eighty years, eighty years!
This huge stone weighing on my heart has finally been lifted!
He finally got rid of the title of waste at the first level of Qi refining!
The effect of the fruit is truly outstanding!
You can really use this to cultivate immortality!
He felt himself carefully. Compared with when he was at the first level of Qi Refining, his spiritual power was nearly half as strong and his perception was sharper.
Even his body is a bit younger, and he feels that he can live another twenty years!
This state is completely different from that of running out of gas when going down the mountain.
Even the wrinkles on his face have faded a bit.
It’s great to be young!
Looking at himself in the mirror, Lin Xun was a little excited.
The road to immortality is difficult, but now that he has a treasure tree, he finally has more possibilities!
He stood up, opened the door and walked into the courtyard.
The sun seems to be particularly bright today, and the sky is clear, which is completely different from the hazy sky filled with clouds and mist in the Immortal Sect.
Golden elixir monk?
Lin Xun clenched his fists and curled up the corners of his mouth!
His Taoist heart is even firmer, but he wants to live forever!
After a while, Lin Xun returned to the room and saw that Yang Yun had tidied up the room, which was virtuous.
When Yang Yun saw the person coming, she lowered her head shyly, "Master, I got up late today and didn't help you change clothes."
Lin Xun touched Yang Yun's head and said indifferently: "You have a good rest on the bed. I will ask the servants to bring vegetables and rice later."
Yang Yun was quite moved, but was soon shocked and speechless by Lin Xun's next sentence.
"Take good care of yourself, I will love you again at night."
Yang Yun's face turned red and she quickly said: "Master, it's better to eat less of that kind of food. I, I am indeed somewhat immune to conquest."
Lin Xun was stunned and stared at Yang Yun for a long time. The little wife was right. Although his cultivation level has improved now, he can do without that thing.
However, Yang Yun is just a mortal and cannot bear it for a long time.
We have to find a way to improve her strength.
Otherwise, just practice martial arts?
Seeing Lin Xun staring at her without speaking, Yang Yun lowered her head and said with a cry:
"Master, I, I can do it, as long as you are gentle tonight."
Lin Xun laughed loudly, stepped forward and pinched Yang Yun's tender face, "Why are you still calling me master? You forgot what you called me last night?"
When Yang Yun heard this, she was like a kitten with exploded fur. She hurriedly buried her head in the quilt and timidly responded: "Husband, husband!"
"Okay, Yun'er, you rest first, I'll be right back."
As soon as Lin Xun opened the door, he met Butler Wang and saw him holding up the bag in his hand like a treasure:
